notes.title: Small update ver 1.3.7

tags.feature: NEW! Blitz mode for 4x4 and 8x8 fields: you have only 2 minutes to get best score;
Added leaderboards to compete with other players and friends;

tags.bug: Fixed bug that prevented unlocking achievements;

notes.title: Gem Forge version 1.3.6
notes.content:
[h3]Gem Forge 1.3.6[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed playing with WSAD keys, 
[*] improved game controller support, 
[*] rebuilt using latest Steam SDK,
[*] macOS version built for 64-bit Intel and Apple Silicon, 
notarized by Apple to run in macOS 10.15 Catalina and later;
[/list]

tags.feature:
[*] macOS version built for 64-bit Intel and Apple Silicon, 
notarized by Apple to run in macOS 10.15 Catalina and later;

notes.title: Version 1.3.5

tags.feature:
[*] added new inventory item -- item box; the item box is dropped every time after Game Over 
when drop time limits are satisfied; the item box can be opened and contains 3 random items;
[*] added game status in Steam Chat when friends are playing;
[*] added arrows below the game field to indicate possible moves: GREEN IS GOOD, RED IS BAD;
[*] added collectable skins for gems that can be crafted

tags.balance_change: [*] Gem Breaker, Chain Breaker, and Tornado removed from the game's item store;

notes.title: Version 1.3.3

tags.bug: [*] fixed bug when music volume at 0% doesn't mute the music;

tags.feature: [*] added gems merging rules in the main menu (just wait a bit in the main menu to see them);

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2 - Items
notes.content:
Version 1.3.2 what's new:
[list]
[*]  added consumable inventory items; tradable, marketable;
[/list]
How to get items:
1. Trade with other players or buy on the market
2. Single bonus item per each friend playing Gem Forge
3. Every day a small chance that item will drop when entering game

tags.feature: added consumable inventory items; tradable, marketable;

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Released

tags.feature: [*]  added new game mode on the 8x8 field
[*]  14 new achievements are ready to be unlocked;
[*]  new music track! is available for those players who unlocked all achievements in 4x4-mode; once unlocked, music tracks can be switched any time in Settings;

notes.title: Version 1.2.0

tags.bug: [*] fixed bug with achievements and score on Mac;

tags.feature: [*] now gems can be merged several times with a single move;
[*] player high score is now stored on Steam;
[*] added animated flame effect instead of static image;

notes.title: Game patch
notes.content:
What's new:
	
- added support for high dpi-enabled monitors with resolution 2560x1440 and higher on Windows.

tags.feature: - added support for high dpi-enabled monitors with resolution 2560x1440 and higher on Windows.
